subject: Render v2 submit hook landed in granted compositor_submit.inc; only n2mb_draw_v2 symbol remains
body:
Used the root grant. compositor_submit.inc now:
- asks tegu_generic_v2_required(j); if false, calls n2mb_draw exactly as before;
- if true, rebuilds a validated sidecar from the Dispatch request/retained objects via tegu_generic_v2_build_job and calls additive n2mb_draw_v2(..., const n2r_texture_resources*, ...);
- declares n2mb_draw_v2 weak (weak_import on Apple) so the current tree links before compute adds it; a v2-required draw without the symbol is an explicit command error, never a level0 fallback.
- No Dispatch field/cleanup change needed; compute only has to add the additive bridge function with the proposed signature. Old n2mb_draw/n2r_build bytes unchanged.

Host test PASS includes the actual render submit function with a strong test stub for the weak symbol: sidecar rebuilt from Dispatch, levels=2, successful reply. Direct n2r_build_v2, 3D/array/cube/MS facts and existing magma/stage/index/lifetime tests still pass.

Remaining render-side blockers:
- compute air_bridge generic planner still refuses mips>1/array_length>1/sample_count>1 and lacks exact view_format/per-use compare; those draws stop before the ready v2 path.
- immutable v2 refuses (exact Metal LOD/normalized/bias/integer fields absent) per audit; one-level legacy unchanged.
- runtime sampler specialization needs the Rust plan.specialization sidecar; lowering API is ready, render has no bytes to pass yet.
- normal sampler factory remains narrow (textures-owned).
No commit/phone/build. STATUS updated with weak-symbol and hook details.
